{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit mock-neck sweater, fitted, hip-length, long sleeves, sapphire blue #1F3F8F, merino wool
Pleated midi skirt, A-line, falling just below the knee, magenta #A8236A, satin-finish crepe
Textured jacket, tailored and slightly cropped, one-button, ink navy #1C2340, bouclé wool
Long coat, straight cut, mid-calf, deep charcoal #2E3038, soft wool-cashmere blend
Ankle boots, pointed toe, block heel, black #161616, smooth leather
Drop earrings, sculptural, polished gold #C9A24B, metal
Clutch, structured, small, silver #C4C7CF, metallic leather
Sheer tights, matte, black #1A1A1A, fine nylon

This outfit stays within a neat, refined theatre look while the saturated sapphire-and-magenta pairing makes it clearly stand out, as you wanted. The jewel tones flatter your cool, fair coloring and echo the blue of your eyes, while the silver in your hair meets the metallic clutch. The textured jacket and pleated skirt add movement and interest without fuss, and the block-heeled boots keep you comfortable from the foyer to your seat. The coat covers the cool autumn evening and comes off easily in the theatre to show the full color play."}
